items.Description: A camp workbench for making furnishings and repairing tools.
A stone-and-timber forge for making and repairing advanced tools.
A tool rack that raises a Workbench to level 2.
An anvil that lets a Forge support higher-tier tools.
A stone wheel for repairing all worn tools at once.
A shared chest for storing camp supplies.
A rack for roasting boar and deer over a fire.
An iron pan for cooking over a lit hearth.
A pot for simmering soups over a fire.
Timber boards for the floor of a camp shelter.
A light timber-and-reed wall that blocks wind around camp.
A reed roof that shields a small camp from rain.
